# Hard Calibration Method for Population Estimation -- ACS5 and ACS1

This code develops counts of individuals by age, by tract as of the year of the most recent ACS 1-year release. It does this by taking age-by-tract counts from the most recent ACS5 release, which of course represents many years, and calibrates the totals to match the corresponding PUMA. This is a "hard" calibration in the sense that we ask the across-tract totals to match the PUMA sum exactly, even though each construct is measured with noise (which should be considered in a more balanced, "soft" calibration approach).

```{r}
# Load prepped data
for (f in c("geo", "acs1", "acs5")) {
  load(file = glue("{output_path}{f}_data_{my_output_tag}.Rda"))
}
```


```{r select acs5 age counts}
ageCounts_t <- 
  acs5tract %>% 
  select(
    matches("GEOID|^rAge")
  )
```

```{r merge PUMA into tract-level data}

ageCounts_pt <- 
  merge(
    ageCounts_t,
    geo_crosswalk %>% select(GEOID, PUMA) %>% unique(),
    by = "GEOID"
  )

stopifnot(nrow(ageCounts_t) == nrow(ageCounts_pt))
```


```{r function to build acs1 counts within age range}
get_puma_totals <- function(bounds) {
  
  stopifnot(all(bounds %in% acs1_elig$AGEP))
  acs1_elig %>% 
    filter(
      between(AGEP, bounds[1], bounds[2])
    ) %>% 
    summarize(
      .by = PUMA,
      n_p_to = sum(PWGTP))
}

stopifnot(
  get_puma_totals(c(0, 5)) %>% 
    filter(PUMA == acs1_elig$PUMA[1]) %>% 
    pull(n_p_to) == 
    acs1_elig %>% 
    filter(
      0 <= AGEP, 
      AGEP <= 5
    ) %>% 
    summarize(
      .by = PUMA,
      n_p_to = sum(PWGTP)
    ) %>% 
    filter(
      PUMA == acs1_elig$PUMA[1]
    ) %>% 
    pull(n_p_to)
)
```

```{r function to get ages from variable name}
get_age_bounds <- function(age_var) {
  if (str_detect(age_var, "\\dto\\d")) {
    bounds <-
      str_extract_all(
        age_var, 
        "\\d+"
      ) %>% 
      unlist() %>% 
      as.numeric()
  } else if (str_detect(age_var, "[Ll]t\\d")) {
    ub <- 
      str_extract(
        age_var, 
        "\\d+"
      ) %>% 
      as.numeric()
    bounds <- c(0, ub - 1)
  } else if (str_detect(age_var, "\\dplus")) {
    lb <- 
      str_extract(
        age_var, 
        "\\d+"
      ) %>% 
      as.numeric()
    bounds <- c(lb, Inf)
  }
  return(bounds)
}

stopifnot(get_age_bounds("rAge0to18")  == c( 0, 18))
stopifnot(get_age_bounds("rAge19to64") == c(19, 64))
stopifnot(get_age_bounds("rAge65plus") == c(65, Inf))
```


```{r function to calibrate}

calibrate_counts <- function(age_var) {
  
  my_bounds <- get_age_bounds(age_var)
  age_counts_p <- get_puma_totals(my_bounds)
  
  ageCounts_pt %>% 
    mutate(
      .by = PUMA,
      n_p_from = sum(get(age_var))
    ) %>% 
    merge(
      age_counts_p,
      by = "PUMA"
    ) %>% 
    mutate(
      calib_mult = n_p_to / n_p_from,
      calib = get(age_var) * calib_mult
    )
}

# Sanity checks
if (FALSE) {
  x <- calibrate_counts("rAge0to18")
  x %>% select(PUMA, calib_mult) %>% unique() %>% pull(calib_mult) %>% hist()
  x %>% 
    filter(
      PUMA %in% unique(PUMA)[1:5]
    ) %>% 
    ggplot() +
    aes(
      x = rAge0to18,
      y = calib
    ) + 
    geom_point() + 
    geom_abline() +
    facet_wrap(
      ~PUMA
    )
}

```


```{r}
batch_calibrations <- function(age_vars) {
  calibs <- 
    lapply(
      age_vars,
      \(a) {
        calibrate_counts(a) %>% 
          select(GEOID, calib) %>% 
          mutate(
            age_var = a,
            year = base_year
          )
      }
    )
  bind_rows(calibs)
}

pop_age_t_calib <- 
  batch_calibrations(
    c(
      "rAge0to18",
      "rAge19to64",
      "rAge65plus"
    )
  )

pop_age_t_calib_wide <- 
  pop_age_t_calib %>% 
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = "GEOID",
    values_from = "calib",
    names_from = "age_var"
  )
```


```{r save long-by-year population data}
save(
  pop_age_t_calib, pop_age_t_calib_wide,
  file = glue("{output_path}pop_data_{my_output_tag}.Rda")
)
```
